description:
Search for messages locally via FTS or remotely via IMAP SEARCH. Returns matching message references.

Use when: Find messages by a local full-text query or a remote IMAP search.
Not for: Use mail_read when the folder and message UID are already known.

before.description: ISO date string — only messages before this date.

folder.description: Restrict search to a specific folder.

query.description: Free-text search query or FTS5 expression.

since.description: ISO date string — only messages after this date.

name: mail_search
